entry.title: PotentialWarp 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialWarp 1.2.0** - **Triplet repeats**: three new step moves, **Repeat 1/8T, 1/16T and 1/32T**, on the EDIT page, and ROLL uses them too (more on WILD). - **SWING** (TIME panel): 50 % (straight) to 75 %, MPC style. The off 16th steps start later, so gates, chops and repeats swing with your beat. - **4 BARS**: a fourth LENGTH, for slow builds and long tape stops. - **STOP FILTER** (OUTPUT panel): a low-pass that closes as a Tape Stop runs down and opens as a Tape Start spins up, like a rea

entry.title: PotentialWarp 1.1.1
entry.summary: **PotentialWarp 1.1.1** - **CPU figure recorded.** Measured on an MPC One with the Open MPC bench: **PASS**, 3.7% of an audio block at the 99th percentile and 4.9% at worst, so it runs comfortably alongside a full project. It shows on the catalog card and in INSTALL.md. - Nothing else changed: same sound, controls and saved projects as 1.1.0. **Downloads** - **`PotentialWarp-1.1.1-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin

entry.title: PotentialWarp 1.1.0
entry.summary: **PotentialWarp 1.1.0** - **Edit the patterns.** A new **EDIT** page: tap a step, then what it does (straight, silent, 1/2 or 1/4 speed, tape stop or start, backwards, spinback, repeat 1/8 to 1/64). Every pad can be changed, the pad's name shows EDITED, and **RESET PAD** puts its own pattern back. - **Dice.** **ROLL** makes a new pattern for the pad, on the beat. **MILD**, **MEDIUM** or **WILD** says how far it goes. - **Chains.** A new **CHAIN** page: up to 8 patterns played in turn, one LENGTH

entry.title: PotentialWarp 1.0.1
entry.summary: **PotentialWarp 1.0.1** - **Ready for MPC OS 3.10.1's plugin folders.** Every download now carries the `plugin.json` that MPC OS 3.10.1 looks for, so the plugin folder can be copied by hand straight into `VST2 Plugins`. - **Gen2 MPCs in the Open MPC catalog.** A separate 64-bit download (`-mpc-aarch64.zip`), so the Plugin Manager can install it on Gen2 MPCs, and the catalog's 3.10.1 download (`-mpc-sdk.zip`). - Built with the current Open MPC kit. Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged

entry.title: PotentialWarp 1.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialWarp 1.0.0**, the first release. A tempo-locked mangler for your MPC, in the spirit of Gross Beat: 16 one-tap patterns of stutters, half speed, tape stops, spinbacks, reverses and gates, locked to your beat.
